title: Hopes and expectations in feedback
summary: This topic centers on owners expressing hopes or expectations, with examples spanning satisfaction with the vehicle, attention to styling, concerns about future issues, color preferences, and whether a complaint will be heard.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the vehicle met expectations or express hope that problems do not continue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention hoped-for styling reactions, a preferred color, or a wish for a complaint to reach someone without enough detail to classify sentiment consistently.

limitations: The topic is loosely connected by the word 'hoping' and mixes unrelated subjects rather than a single coherent product issue.
Several fragments are too brief or ambiguous to determine clear sentiment beyond the stated hope or expectation.
The examples are limited, so they do not support broader conclusions about this topic.
